review.tagline: PyTorch library for distributed training of large models with ZeRO
review.summary: DeepSpeed is a PyTorch optimization library for training large deep learning models across many GPUs. It provides ZeRO memory partitioning with CPU and NVMe offload, 3D parallelism, Ulysses sequence parallelism and MoE support, configured through a JSON file. It integrates with Hugging Face Transformers and Accelerate, Lightning, MosaicML Composer, Determined and MMEngine.
review.audience: ML engineers training or fine-tuning large models on multi-GPU clusters
strengths: Used to train models such as BLOOM 176B and Megatron-Turing NLG 530B
Integrates with Hugging Face Transformers/Accelerate, Lightning, Composer, Determined and MMEngine
Supports NVIDIA, AMD, Intel Gaudi/XPU/CPU, Huawei Ascend NPU and Tecorigin accelerators
Installs from PyPI; C++/CUDA ops are JIT-compiled or pre-built
weaknesses: Needs PyTorch installed first and a CUDA or ROCm compiler for JIT ops
Mainly tested on NVIDIA Pascal to Hopper and AMD MI100/MI200
Windows lacks async IO and GDS support
Large JSON config surface; ZeRO and offload tuning requires reading the docs
needs: Needs PyTorch, CUDA or ROCm compiler (nvcc/hipcc), ninja
Models: PyTorch models, Hugging Face Transformers
